narrative: Quantitative Risk & Performance Audit: The audited trading system demonstrates an asymmetric positive edge characterized by a 2.02:1 Risk/Reward payoff ratio and an Expectancy Value of ₹7,229.86 (+3.61% on ₹200,000 position capital) despite a sub-50% win rate (46.40%). The Profit Factor of 1.75 confirms robust edge resilience against loss runs (max consecutive loss streak of 5). However, at the macro portfolio level, performance is severely dampened by severe cash underutilization: fixed 2.0% allocation per signal across only 125 trades in 11.34 years (~11 trades/year) generated a CAGR of only 0.77%, trailing Indian risk-free benchmarks despite low portfolio volatility (0.90%) and a shallow maximum drawdown (-2.91% / ₹-301,816.69). Tail-risk metrics remain benign with positive Fisher-Pearson skewness (+0.15) and a Sortino Ratio of 1.76, confirming downside containment. To unlock full quantitative potential, portfolio capital efficiency must be addressed via concurrent position scaling, dynamic volatility-adjusted sizing (e.g., fractional Kelly or ATR parity), or yield overlay on idle cash balances.
